protocol_delta.gate: flip-capability gate on paid actions after S1^S2^S3; 3 consecutive rejections end the run

addenda.hard: Protocol addendum (DISCOVER-V2-STOP, arm S-hard). The environment ends the episode automatically after the first action following which the stopping rule S1 (feasible lowest-cost candidate identified), S2 (no unresolved candidate) and S3 (backward parity and reachability classified for the highest-activity candidate versus the winner, when they differ) all hold; your final answer is then read from the environment state. Plan your calculations so that the decision is complete when the rule first holds.
addenda.gate: Protocol addendum (DISCOVER-V2-STOP, arm S-gate). Once the stopping rule S1, S2 and S3 holds, the environment arms a gate: a paid action is executed only if its result can still change the winner, the decision pair or the reachability verdict. Admissible paid actions while the gate is armed are CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY (any scope); BUILD_PROCESS_WINDOW and OPTIMIZE_PROCESS of the winner or the highest-activity candidate only while the environment reports an edge flag (their optimum, or the parity state, lies on an edge of its window that is not a bound of the full domain), in a window other than the one already used; BACKWARD for the pair only after such a re-optimisation; TEST_REACHABILITY only after a new BACKWARD. Every other paid action (RUN_MC, TEST_LEVER, repeat windows on validated optima, optimisation of other candidates) is rejected at 0 CU with the reason, and three consecutive rejections end the episode. Free actions are never gated. Each tool result carries a _v2 field with the gate state, the edge flags and the admissible paid actions; when _v2.S3prime_validated_stop is true, nothing paid can change the decision and you should STOP.
addenda.anytime: Protocol addendum (DISCOVER-V2-STOP, arm S-anytime). Regardless of the size of your allowance, reach the stopping rule S1, S2 and S3 at the minimum spend first: use the smallest process window that can contain the candidates' optima, optimise only the candidates that can be the industrial choice, then run BACKWARD and TEST_REACHABILITY. Widen or rebuild a window only if the environment's _v2.edge_flags report that the optimum of the winner or of the highest-activity candidate, or the parity state, lies on a window edge that is not a bound of the full domain. When _v2.S3prime_validated_stop is true, STOP; do not spend remaining allowance on calculations that cannot change the winner, the decision pair or the reachability verdict.
